leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to structure form data with multiple fields across steps
Implement useState hooks to manage form data and track the current step
Apply conditional rendering to display different form sections based on the current step
Construct a component structure with separate sections for each step of the form
Utilize event handlers to update form data when input values change
Control navigation between steps with functions that increment and decrement the step counter
Execute validation logic to check required fields before allowing progression to the next step
Implement a progress indicator component that visually represents the current step
Use props to pass form data and handlers between parent and child form step components
Return a complete multi-step form component with all navigation and data flow functionality
